description: This class handles delete commands for payment types in the Fineract microfinance software. It processes delete requests for payment types by delegating to a service class.

classes.name: DeletePaymentTypeCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles delete commands for payment types, orchestrates the delete operation via PaymentTypeWriteService.

methods.name: DeletePaymentTypeCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with PaymentTypeWriteService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by calling the delete method on the payment type write service.
